name: Klein / Harris
description: If you've ever wondered what Canadian cuisine really is beyond poutine and maple syrup, go to this hidden gem! Everything is local, fresh, and inventive.
personalNote: Perfect stop while visiting Stephen Avenue.

name: Kawa Espresso Bar
description: They've got it all - licensed bar, great coffee, great food, and often have local musician performances. Part of Calgary's jazz scene.
personalNote: Great spot for coffee, drinks, and local music.

name: Bridgette Bar
description: Fine dining done right. Popular venue for date nights and corporate parties.
personalNote: An upscale favorite for date nights on 10th Ave.

name: Posto Pizzeria & Bar
description: Can't beat their happy hour half-price pizzas after 9PM.
personalNote: Unbeatable late-night pizza deal in the Beltline.

name: Kama
description: Tapas tapas tapas - hard to describe this place since I can't pronounce half the ingredients on the menu. Prepare to feel uncultured!
personalNote: Incredible selection of Spanish-inspired tapas sharing plates.

name: ZCREW Cafe
description: My top recommendation for dine-in brunch. Reservations recommended.
personalNote: Arrive early or book ahead for an exceptional brunch experience.

name: Village Ice Cream
description: This is where the local small-batch ice cream craze all started. I recommend their melted chocolate and north 49 honeyberry.
personalNote: A legendary local sweet treat stop after exploring the East Village or RiverWalk.

name: Vero Bistro Moderne
description: A small chef-driven restaurant in the heart of Kensington offering exquisite modern bistro fare.
personalNote: Intimate atmosphere and exceptional culinary execution just across the river from Eau Claire.

name: Bubblemania
description: The hangout place for all the Asian families in town. Go for a taste of Taiwanese snacks and bubble tea!
personalNote: Cozy spot for authentic bubble tea and comforting snacks in Chinatown.

name: Ikusa Izakaya
description: Calgary-based chain for quality sushi, Japanese BBQ and ramen at reasonable prices.
personalNote: Great casual spot for comforting bowls of ramen and grilled skewers.

name: 4th Spot Kitchen & Bar
description: A trendy neighborhood gastropub serving comfort food like pizza, burgers, and pasta.
personalNote: A relaxed local neighborhood hub with fantastic comfort food.
